Native inventory independently starts all five present hub roots. Source0/source4 receive fixture DHCP; independent DeviceFinder/full menus/exact PDB/audio and same-generation refresh pass for those two. Other three sources log ACTIVE through emulator NAT DHCP but do not have complete independent client acceptance here. A controlled native secondary-address addition triggers global retirement, all five EMPTY states, SDK-observed helper exit and scheduled restart. Test stops the managed emulator unit before restart; restart itself is not tested. Namespaces gone, native network, normal package restoration and owned cleanup pass. No native eject, local playback, external loaded deck, Link-mode policy, target4.4 execution or physical CDJ acceptance.
